title: Correlated Subquery for Department Average
description: Find employees whose salary exceeds their department's average using a correlated subquery.

data.text: Find all employees whose salary is above the average salary of their own department.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Department, Salary
FROM Employees e1
WHERE Salary > (
    SELECT AVG(Salary)
    FROM Employees e2
    WHERE e2.Department = e1.Department
)
ORDER BY Department, Salary DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: The inner subquery references e1.Department from the outer query — this is a correlated subquery. It runs once per outer row. While logically clear, CTEs with window functions (AVG() OVER PARTITION BY) are usually more efficient for this pattern.
